title: Correct Ding
blurb: Crisp, civilised, and entirely pleased with itself. Where the wrong-answer buzzer screams at you, this one simply confirms you are right and moves on. Quiz-show official, no fuss, no celebration beyond what the occasion warrants. That restraint is what makes it so pleasant to trigger over and over. Use it for trivia nights, for teaching moments, and for dignifying the small daily victories nobody else intends to acknowledge — the right platform, the correct change, remembering a name on the second attempt. The gold star of sounds, available on demand.
origin: The classic right-answer chime of quiz culture.
